mechanism_narrative: Increasing GDP indicates strong economic growth, which should positively impact corporate earnings and drive up stock prices over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: GDP growth is positive but S&P 500 returns are negative over the 60-day horizon in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in unemployment rate indicates a weakening labor market, which could lead to decreased consumer spending and negative impacts on corporate revenues, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE increases by 0.2pp in one month
failure_condition: UNRATE rises but S&P 500 shows positive returns in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When federal funds rate is low and unemployment rate is high, it may indicate a policy response to economic weakness, which could lead to market instability and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: The specified conditions are met but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 30% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, higher federal funds rates increase borrowing costs, which can negatively impact corporate profitability and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS increases but S&P 500 returns remain positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Growth in non-farm payroll employment indicates a strong labor market, which should positively impact consumer spending and corporate revenues, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS growth is positive but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in CPI suggests higher inflation, which may lead to tighter monetary policy and negatively impact equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL increases by 0.5% in one month
failure_condition: CPI increases but S&P 500 returns remain positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP growth is strong and industrial production is increasing, it indicates a robust economy, which should lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: Both conditions are met but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 30% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, increased housing starts may indicate continued economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: Housing starts increase but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.
